# AI Feedback Session with LeoVegas
Date: 2026-11-18 | Duration: 69m

## Summary
LeoVegas moved from LaunchDarkly to GrowthBook after an acquisition created overlapping experimentation platforms, with rollout across sportsbook, gaming, landing pages, native apps, and CMS-managed experiences. Joanna is the sole remaining experimentation specialist, while product managers are expected to run experiments, review results, and record ship, iterate, or do-not-ship decisions. Uplift tests and release validations now use one workflow supported by scheduled stops and weekly Claude setup checks. Claude assists with hypothesis reviews, result summaries, and QA, while write access is deferred in favor of REST APIs, webhooks, and Atlassian automation. GrowthBook is now the source of experiment history, and planned quality scoring will assess issues such as SRM, insufficient data, restarts, and re-randomization. Joanna requested audience-based power analysis, dynamic stop extensions, automated summaries, staging filters, guardrail-only recommendations, and customized AI checks. Slack integration and data warehouse consolidation remain dependent on approval and ongoing restructuring.

## Keywords
Experiment automation, GrowthBook, Claude MCP, Experiment quality, Power analysis, Feature experimentation
